title: MEPS 2020: people with a reported ICD-10 U07 (COVID-19)
definition: People with at least one condition record whose 3-character ICD10CDX equals U07.
method: Sum of unique-person weights (PERWT20F) over the domain; standard error by Taylor linearisation over VARSTR/VARPSU. Person-level, one year only.
comparability: U07 marks a reported COVID-19 condition, not Long COVID; use only as population context.
MEPS panels overlap across adjacent years: never add or pool these yearly totals.
Condition rows come from household reports coded by professional coders.
summary: 2020: about 12,453,867 people (95% CI 11,007,615 to 13,900,120; 970 sampled persons) reported a condition coded U07.
how_to_use: Cross-check or population context only, never a prevalence of Lyme or Long COVID; not a cost estimate (events are counts, not dollars).

provenance.collection_note: Respondent-reported conditions and hours, coded to ICD-10 by MEPS abstractors; not a clinical record.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: U07 marks a reported COVID-19 condition, not Long COVID; use only as population context.
provenance.reliability: 970 sampled persons with a design-based standard error.
